title: CondoGuard Liability Rating: Policy Tenure Multiplier
content:
Rating rule of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy for the liability step premium charged on a liability raise.

**Rule.** The tenure multiplier on the liability step premium is 0.85 when the policy has been in force for 120 or more whole months since its first inception date, 0.92 when it has been in force for 60 to 119 whole months, and 1.00 when it has been in force for fewer than 60 whole months. The multiplier is applied to the tier's liability step premium itself, before the full-year liability step charge is rounded. Where the liability step premium carries more than one multiplier, the multipliers are first multiplied together and then applied once to the tier's liability step premium; none of them acts on the result of another.

**Measure.** Tenure is the number of whole months from the policy's first inception date, as shown on the policy record, to the day of the raise; a part month is not counted.

| Whole months in force since first inception | Tenure multiplier |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 0.85 |
| 60 to 119 | 0.92 |
| fewer than 60 | 1.00, the step premium is not adjusted for tenure |

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical tenures)

- 119 whole months: 0.92. 120 whole months: 0.85.
- 59 whole months: 1.00. 60 whole months: 0.92.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A tier liability step premium of 14.00 USD on a policy with 130 whole months in force, with no other multiplier on the step premium: 14.00 multiplied by 0.85 is 11.90 USD for the full-year liability step charge of one step.
